summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Overlay Shares Municipal Bond ETF (OVM) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in investment grade fixed income. The fund is actively managed to provide exposure to U.S. municipal bonds combined with a U.S OVM was launched on Sep 30, 2019 and is issued by Liquid Strategies.
